title: account_nfts
key_points: The account_nfts method retrieves the NFTs associated with an XRP Ledger account.
It requires providing a valid Account ID as input.
The response includes a list of NFT objects, each containing metadata about the corresponding NFT.
limitations: This documentation page provides general information and usage examples. It may not cover all possible scenarios or edge cases.
For up-to-date details and specific implementation guidance, consult the official XRP Ledger documentation or API reference.
asserts: The account_nfts method allows retrieving information about NFTs associated with a specified XRP Ledger account by providing its Account ID as input.
